d: Tivoli Hotels & Resorts is a collection of luxury hotels and resorts set in idyllic beaches and cosmopolitan locations, from iconic destinations in Europe to the Middle East, and from Brazil to Asia. We are timeless, dedicated, and distinctive — evoking a time when hotel stays were grand experiences and travel meant life slowed down for a while.

Founded in 1933, Tivoli’s long-standing heritage is built on extraordinary service, authentic local experiences, and a genuine dedication to the art of hospitality. If you share a passion for making every guest feel they have arrived somewhere truly special, Tivoli is where your story belongs.

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and people-focused Director of People & Culture (P&C) to lead the pre-opening and launch of all human resources and organizational development initiatives at Tivoli Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort and Avani Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort.

This senior leadership role is responsible for building the hotel’s workforce from the ground up, establishing a strong organizational culture, and ensuring that all P&C processes and programs support operational excellence and employee engagement from day one.
r: Lead all pre-opening HR and P&C planning, including recruitment, onboarding, training, and team structure across all departments.
Develop and implement HR policies, procedures, and SOPs in line with brand standards, local labor laws, and organizational culture goals.
Build and maintain a strong pre-opening recruitment pipeline, ensuring timely hiring of skilled and motivated talent.
Design and execute comprehensive training and development programs to ensure all team members are prepared for opening and operational excellence.
Foster a positive, inclusive, and performance-driven culture aligned with the values of Tivoli and Avani brands.
Oversee payroll, benefits administration, performance management, and employee relations, ensuring compliance with labor regulations.
Provide guidance and support to departmental leaders on HR matters, conflict resolution, and talent management.
Develop succession planning and career development strategies for key positions.
Collaborate closely with the Hotel Manager and ownership to align P&C strategies with business goals.
Implement HR systems, reporting mechanisms, and metrics to monitor workforce performance, engagement, and retention.

This role is ideal for a pre-opening P&C leader with strong hospitality experience, proven recruitment and organizational development skills, and the ability to create a high-performing and engaged workforce from day one.
At least Bachelor Degree in Human Resources Management or any related fields
At least 5 years experiences in international companies with evidence tracked record of achievements.
Strong in interpersonal and communication skills.
Proficiency in English and computer literate
Knowledge of Bahrain labor laws and HR practices preferred
Strong in driving results and people management and development
Key Competencies Required; Coaching & Developing Others, Facilitating Change, Aligning Strategies into Results, Innovation, Problem Analysis and Decision Making.

d: Job Title: SAP SuccessFactors Platform Lead – Arabic Speaking

We are looking for an experienced SAP SuccessFactors Platform Lead to lead a large-scale, greenfield SAP SuccessFactors implementation for a leading Gulf-based airline. The candidate will be responsible for managing end-to-end implementation delivery, stakeholder engagement, project governance and coordination across multiple HR modules.
q: 10+ years of overall IT/HR technology experience.
Minimum 5+ years of experience in SAP HCM / SuccessFactors project management.
Strong hands-on project delivery experience in SAP SuccessFactors implementations.
Experience delivering at least 2–4 end-to-end Employee Central implementations.
Strong understanding of multiple SuccessFactors modules and implementation lifecycle management.
Excellent stakeholder management, leadership and communication skills.
Fluency in Arabic and proficiency in English are mandatory.
Experience in large-scale, multi-country HR transformation programmes.
r: Lead end-to-end SAP SuccessFactors implementation projects, preferably with 2–4 full lifecycle Employee Central implementations.
Manage project planning, execution, delivery, monitoring and closure.
Coordinate cross-functional teams across Employee Central (EC), Recruitment (RCM), Onboarding (ONB), Performance & Goals (PMGM), Compensation (COMP), Learning (LMS) and Payroll.
Drive stakeholder management, customer communication and project governance.
Manage project risks, issues, dependencies and escalations.
Coordinate functional and technical teams to ensure quality and timely delivery.
Oversee implementation lifecycle, reporting, steering committee presentations and compliance with delivery standards.
Mentor team members and ensure effective collaboration across project teams.
